narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>A metre is a hundred millimetres, so eighteen thousand coins match the statue.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But ten millimetres make a centimetre, and a hundred centimetres make a metre.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That gives a thousand millimetres, so the slip is struck out.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Use one unit for both of the heights.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Divide the total height by the thickness of one coin.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A thousand millimetres make a metre.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words same unit appear; the words divide by one coin appear; the words 1000 mm = 1 m appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip changes metres to millimetres with the wrong factor. A metre has a thousand millimetres.
